reader.requirement: WRITE on an indexed file raises the invalid key condition when (a) sequential access in OUTPUT/EXTEND and the prime key is not greater than the previous one (21), (b) OUTPUT or I-O and the prime key already exists (22), (c) OUTPUT, EXTEND or I-O and a no-DUPLICATES alternate key value already exists (22), (d) the write would pass the file's implementor-defined boundary (24).

reader.notes: Items a-c probed at 85 under sequential and dynamic access in OUTPUT, EXTEND and I-O, with variable-length records. Item d is the store's 2^32-page format bound or the host's file-size refusal (PagedFile#Reserve -> StoreStatus.Boundary -> RecordWriteFailed '24'), read in code and not probed under the host-safety rule (unit tests FileBoundaryTests and PagedFileBoundaryTests exist). A duplicate prime under sequential OUTPUT answers 21, a choice IX-3 gives the implementor when 21 and 22 both apply.

refuter.evidence: Probe r1alt.cob (r1alt-001, --std 85): sequential file with a unique alternate key and a DUPLICATES alternate key. Under OUTPUT: A002AAADDD -> IK 22 (GR17c), A003BBBDDD -> OK 02. Under EXTEND (what the reader did not probe): B001AAAEEE -> IK 22 (GR17c under extend), B002CCCDDD -> OK 02, B002DDDEEE -> IK 21 (GR17a), B003BBBFFF -> IK 22; read back holds only A001, A003, B002CCC, B004. Item a and b fail for U+00FF against U+FFFF: probe r3hv.cob (r3hv-001) sequential -> 'SEQ W2 IK 21', random -> 'RND W2 IK 22' for two prime keys that differ in the native sequence ('NATIVE: K2 > K1'); same at --std 2023 (r3hv23-002). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:IX.4.9.4 GR17  (4.9.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR17' (quotes from a and c).
